nodes.prompt:
Round 4 of 10 Evolutionary Multi-Agent Autonomous Orchestration:

Goal:
Implement Time-Travel Execution Step Scrubber, Node Upstream/Downstream Dependency & Impact Matrix, Cost & Cognitive Token Footprint Breakdown, and Multi-Run Comparison Diffing View in GVUI.

Work Breakdown:
1. Task T-01: GVUI Time-Travel Execution Step Scrubber & Animation Engine (`src/components/PlaybackControls/`, `src/engine/GraphCanvas/`, `src/store/useGraphStore.ts`)
   - Interactive time-travel execution scrubber allowing users to step backward/forward through graph execution events (steps 1..N, play/pause, speed controls: 0.5x, 1x, 2x, 5x), dynamically updating active node states and pulsing active edges.
   - Gate: `bun test src/components/PlaybackControls && bun test src/engine/GraphCanvas`

2. Task T-02: GVUI Node Dependency & Blast-Radius Impact Inspector (`src/components/NodeDetailDrawer/tabs/DependenciesTab.tsx`, `src/components/NodeDetailDrawer/tabs/ImpactGraph.tsx`)
   - Dedicated Dependencies tab in Node Detail Drawer rendering direct prerequisites, downstream dependents, topological depth, transitive blast radius, and blocker chains with click-to-jump node links.
   - Gate: `bun test src/components/NodeDetailDrawer`

3. Task T-03: GVUI Cost & Cognitive Token Footprint Visualizer (`src/components/Sidebar/TokenFootprintBreakdown.tsx`, `src/components/NodeDetailDrawer/tabs/CostTab.tsx`)
   - Detailed financial & token analytics: input tokens, output tokens, reasoning/thinking tokens, cache read/write tokens, cumulative cost in USD, and model tier cost comparisons.
   - Gate: `bun test src/components/Sidebar && bun test src/components/NodeDetailDrawer`

4. Task T-04: GVUI Multi-Run Comparison & Topology Diffing View (`src/components/ComparisonView/`, `src/store/useGraphFilesStore.ts`)
   - Multi-graph run comparison view comparing two execution runs (e.g. Round 1 vs Round 2) showing node/edge diffs, execution duration deltas, token consumption deltas, and repaired findings.
   - Gate: `bun test src/components/ComparisonView`
